teacher_info.introduction:
Hello! My name is Oxana. I'm a native Russian speaker living in Moscow. I give lessons of Russian to students of all levels. Whether you want to learn basic everyday phrases, or achieve good writing skills, or read Leo Tolstoy's "War & Peace" in original - I'll be glad to help. 

My TESOL certification allows me to teach English to learners of all levels. However, students who'd benefit from my lessons most of all are native Russian speakers, who can't communicate with English native speakers efficiently yet. Please note that I prefer NOT to teach kids online since in my opinion they need different approach.

My main goal is to help you begin talking and communicating. I am proud when my students make progress.The best reward for me is when my students overcome their “no mistakes” mindset or shyness, and begin interacting in their target language. 

Individual approach - My lessons are student-centered. I create a personalized learning plan for each student. 

I love both teaching and learning languages online. Being an enthusiastic language learner helps me enrich my teaching experience. 

Learning Materials - I have a collection of textbooks that I can share with my students. I also believe online tools are very helpful for learning languages. So, I create various materials and I also post learning materials on social media

Здравствуйте! Меня зовут Оксана. С 2011 года я преподаю онлайн английский язык и русский язык как иностранный. Имею сертификат TESOL (международно признанная квалификация для преподавателей английского). На уроках я использую визуальные материалы, игры и упражнения. Веду страницы в соцсетях, посвященные изучению иностранных языков. Буду рада видеть вас в числе своих студентов! Обратите внимание: я считаю, что обучение через Skype - не лучший вариант для детей до 18 лет, поэтому я не принимаю такие запросы.

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need a conversation partner, a study buddy? Are you struggling to find someone to regularly practice speaking English with? Then this course is perfect for you.

NB: I offer conversational classes for students at A2+ to B1+ levels only. If your level is still A2, you might find them a bit challenging. If your level is above B2, you might find them a bit easy.

I believe that the best way to learn a language is through practice and real-life conversations. My goal is to create a comfortable space where everyone feels encouraged to express themselves. I value active participation and believe that making mistakes is an essential part of the learning journey.

I will guide you through a variety of interesting topics and provide useful and constructive feedback to help you improve your English reading, listening, vocabulary, and conversation skills. We'll cover a wide range of subjects, from everyday situations to current events, allowing you to express your thoughts and opinions freely. 
-

I have created lots of teaching materials which we can use to guide our chat. My lessons are well-structured and aesthetically designed. During our trial class, you will have the opportunity to see them firsthand. Most of the time you receive the preparation materials one day prior to our class. The presentation usually starts with some pictures related to the topic we will be discussing, followed by a pre-received article and a vocabulary list. There will be discussion questions to facilitate our conversation. At the conclusion of each lesson, I will provide you with feedback on your performance.

If you have any specific requests, or you want to practice conversing on a particular topic, please feel free to send me a message. I will be happy to help you as best as I can.

But if he had been skilled in Russian, he would have added that one could speak it with all of them, for he would have found in it the magnificence of Spanish, the vivacity of French, the strength of German, the delicacy of Italian, and in addition the richness and conciseness of Greek and Latin. 

Привет! My name is Ksana. I would be glad to help you learn our language and grasp our culture. I am always happy to see my students’ progress as the result of our collaboration. 

I graduated in linguistics and education in 2010. I am a language tutor online with 4 years of experience. I've had students from many countries so I can foresee what difficulties learners may have depending on their background. Progress implies leaving your comfort zone, and I am here to help you leave it in friendly and understanding atmosphere. In most cases learners are interested in speaking activities during the lessons. I totally agree with them because speaking is the activity a person cannot do alone. So this time with a native speaker is really invaluable. But for people who need a guide in the Russian grammar jungle – I am here for you.

I am very flexible, and I customize lessons for my students’ needs. I will provide you with necessary materials. I use Google Docs for your questions and my corrections. 
If you book a trial or first lesson, would you please send me a message with the information about your goal and level. Packages are available.

I am looking forward to meeting you, brave learners of the Russian language! Thanks and see you!

pro_course_detail.title: Russian for beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are for those who just want to get a taste of the Russian language :)

We will learn:
- how to pronounce Russian sounds correctly
- how to read in cyrillic
- basic A1-A2 vocab 
- to say basic information about yourself, your family, daily routine and other topics on your request.

I use a textbook and give a fair amount of comments which help you avoid common mistakes. I create a Google Sheet for us where we keep the vocab which is relevant for you.

I can also create a deck of flashcards for you on Memrise or Quizlet.

Be my student and it's gonna be an interesting journey! :)

pro_course_detail.title: Mastery of basic communication skills (L1)
pro_course_detail.description:
Week 1 - 4 course of 12 week program 

Lesson one: Mastery of greetings and introductions;
+ Mastery of Introductions (Formal, Informal)
+ Practicing understanding of varieties of greeting
( Be able to confidently introduce yourself, ask about someones day and respond in diverse social settings )

Lesson two: Mastering Question Formation and Simple responses
+ Mastery of forming basic questions in various tenses ( Present, past and future )
+ Mastering answers in both simple and extended forms
( Engage in conversation by asking and answering a variety of questions related to personal information or career goals )

Lesson three: Mastering Daily routines and simple actions
+ Mastering verb form and creating meaningful descriptions of daily life 
(Be able to discuss and write about ones daily schdule, explaining the sequence of actions clearly and coherently )

Lesson four: Mastering career related vocabulary and simple conversations
+ Mastery of office related vocabulary and being able to hold brief conversation in professional setting
( Confidently role play scenarios of professional eloquence )

Final lesson = Test results and overall level review
